additional_info.body:
Hi Ferdinand,
I have investigated the charger and given Hard Reboot.
Charger is still out of order.
For the Customer Query,
" QA26 Safety relay error has made the chargers unavailable. We can't confirm the E-stops are physically pressed on site. "
Since in following Error Flag, We don't see Error Flag of Emergency Stop Button, We can ascertain that the E-Stop was not pressed.
We need to troubleshoot as per

Good Morning Liz,
Hope you are doing well.
We understand that after the on-site review by the customer's technician, they were able to bring the charger back into operation.
Noting there was some behaviour around the emergency stop button being pressed as well as some potentially the PLC triggering the emergency trip line.
The PLC interaction with the charger on the emergency trip line is being investigated by the customer.
Do you require any additional information assist from us?

additional_info.subject: RE: 0428955 - ID0428955-DC/Si-D/NZ-[Y2/R5 313059216001] QA26 Safety relay error CRM:00312000075
additional_info.body:
Dear Liz,
Just wanted to inform you that this case will now be closed.
Problem Description:
Chargers were out of order with QA26 Safety relay tripped.
Resolution:
The ELMS has set the trip line for the emergency stop and was reporting to the charger it was tripped.
Customer stated they will follow this up from their side and request any further assistance as needed.
If you need any further assistance, you can get in contact with us here → www.siemens.com/emobility-service-request
Kindly note that email responses to closed tickets are not monitored.
With Kind Regards,
